reviewed_slices.finding: Coherent contract for modes, states, blockers, receipt shape, handoff refs, privacy, default-off behavior, post-archive-only behavior, and non-claims.
Sidecar plan is explicit: decision_work/ artifacts are separate from core run artifacts and raw/private export is off by default.
Manual bundle generation can create generated/deferred/blocked sidecars from safe inputs and refuses unsafe output paths by default.
Eligibility gate maps explicit artifact and triage status to generated, blocked, deferred, and agent-only states without semantic inference.
Receipt renderer is compact, caveated, and state-aware; it does not render full briefs by default.
Agent handoff carries refs, missingness, privacy status, route outputs, and non-claims while preserving agent_action_authorized false.
Runtime hook is default off, post-archive, non-blocking, fail-closed, sidecar-only, and avoids SKILL.md and scripts/skill/* changes.

generated_available_case.finding: Manual bundle can package safe rendered/enriched brief refs and a triage read into a generated state.

blocked_hard_failure_case.finding: Missing required revised-answer artifact produces a blocked sidecar without failing archive completion.

agent_only_or_caveated_case.finding: Explicit cofounder triage categories route a generated attachment to generated_agent_only.

default_off_case.finding: With the flag absent, no runtime sidecar is written.

user_receipt_read.available: Short receipt points to the full brief and evidence bundle while preserving the audit-summary caveat.
user_receipt_read.blocked: Blocked receipt names the blocked reason and does not claim advice correctness.
user_receipt_read.caveated: Caveated receipt stays compact and does not turn triage into a rating.

agent_handoff_read.privacy: Refs, missingness, route outputs, and non-claims are present; raw/private content, provider text, private ledgers, and local absolute paths are excluded.

strongest_useful_signal: The runtime path now has a default-off post-archive sidecar that can record generated, blocked, deferred, and agent-only Decision Work Brief attachment states without changing live answer generation.
strongest_unresolved_risk: Runtime-attached v1 can defer safely, but it still does not automatically create a semantically rich brief from live private context; safe brief supply and user-facing product design remain future work.
recommended_next_pr: PR168 Decision Work Brief Runtime-Attached Internal v1 Follow-up Planning v0
